pins.title: Non-Traditional Med School Applicant? What Actually Counts
pins.description: Worried your path to med school looks too winding? Jobs, long commitments, unplanned research and even a career change all count! What to include, how AMCAS fits a non-traditional story, and a free one-page map-your-path worksheet from a current med student.

pins.quote: My path to med school was anything but straight
pins.headline: Here's how to map yours
pins.sub: What counts + a free story worksheet
pins.title: From Piano Performance Major to Med Student: Mapping a Non-Traditional Path
pins.description: I studied piano performance, worked as an ophthalmic tech and took the DAT before choosing medicine. Here's what I learned about telling a non-traditional story, plus a free worksheet to map your own path to med school. You've got this!

pins.headline: Took the scenic route to med school?
pins.sub: Map your chapters, find the thread, and practice "why now?"
pins.title: Free Worksheet: Map Your Non-Traditional Path to Med School
pins.description: A free one-page worksheet for non-traditional med school applicants: list your chapters, what each one gave you, the thread to medicine, your top 3 most meaningful experiences and letter writers, plus 3 questions to practice out loud.

pins.headline: Map your path to med school
pins.title: How to Tell Your Non-Traditional Story on Your Med School Application
pins.description: Find the thread, not the pivot! Use a simple 3-beat arc, show instead of announce, explain gaps plainly and line up letters early. Advice for non-traditional med school applicants and a free printable worksheet.

pins.headline: AMCAS activities for a winding path
items: Extra date ranges for repeated activities
pins.title: AMCAS Work and Activities for Non-Traditional Applicants (2027 Cycle)
pins.description: Per the AAMC's 2027 AMCAS webinar: up to 15 Work and Activities entries, up to 3 most meaningful, extra date ranges for activities you returned to, and anticipated hours through August 2027. How to use them for a non-traditional story, plus a free worksheet. Confirm in the current AMCAS guide!
